literal_Vinberg_audit.criterion: Vinberg edge-endpoint criterion plus every irreducible affine component's full zero-neighborhood

scope.positive_gain: an explicit eight-moduli equation-level full-Picard K3 carrier, with a literal basis marking and all 28 walls

theorem: On a nonempty Zariski-open set the displayed eight-moduli Jacobian elliptic K3 family has fibers I0*+6I2+6I1, trivial Mordell--Weil group, and exact NS=U+D4(-1)+A1(-1)^6.  The explicit determinant-minus-one marking attaches every oriented mirror and reflection of the finite-volume noncompact A18 C03 H11/28 chamber.

very_general_picard_lattice.generic_rank_argument: the eight family tangents are transverse to the full four-dimensional coordinate orbit, so the moduli image has dimension eight, equal to 20-rank(NS); Noether-Lefschetz jumps are proper
very_general_picard_lattice.torsion_saturation: all reducible component groups are 2-primary; nontrivial torsion would contain a two-torsion point.  The witness two-torsion coefficient ideal is the unit ideal, and two-torsion monodromy type is locally constant on the fixed-fiber open, so the very-general MW torsion is trivial

weierstrass_family.fibers: I0* at t=0; I2 at the six roots of S; I1 at the six roots of H
weierstrass_family.normalization: S(0)=u(0)=1, [t]u=2, [t^5]u=1; the exact tangent calculation is transverse to PGL2 plus Weierstrass homothety
weierstrass_family.parameter_open: s6 != 0 plus the displayed discriminants and resultants
